decision.overall_rationale: The episodes are effectively tied across the sequence. Twelve of thirteen implementations are identical, including the same substantive defects. output-373d346789e2 is only marginally stronger on the release brief, which is insufficient for an overall winner.

task_ratings.rationale: Both preserve the signature, tuple, and required ordering. The second is slightly clearer for a nontechnical reader because it uses a complete purpose statement and explicitly labels the operational step.
The implementations are identical. Both incorrectly select the last record without checking signature status, effective time, failure state, or relative recency among applicable policies.
The implementations are identical. Both retain process-global reservation state and ignore job_id, so reservations can still leak between sequential jobs.
The implementations are identical. Both discard decision_at and blindly select the last source, ignoring authority, applicability, failures, future timestamps, and recency tie-breaking.
The implementations are identical. Both update persistent global state, so keys omitted by a later request remain and leak across sequential calls.
The implementations are identical. Both ignore differs and authorized, claim replacement will occur without authorization, and provide no recoverable proposed path.
The implementations are identical. Both invent another authorization gate despite explicit caller authorization and omit a recoverability action before replacing differing content.
The implementations are identical. Both normalize values but neither remove duplicates nor sort the resulting tags.
The implementations are identical. Both interpolate paths without shell quoting, so spaces and shell metacharacters are not treated as literal data.
The implementations are identical. Both place the purpose after the commands and interpolate paths without quoting, violating both the ordering and literal-path requirements.
The implementations are identical. Both avoid an extra permission gate but provide no recoverability step before replacing differing user-managed content.

The implementations are identical. Both retain prior global health when checks is empty, so an empty check after a degraded call still reports degraded instead of computing the current call independently.
The implementations are identical. Both discard non-completed ledger rows, omit required outcome counts, and classify any nonempty completed set as positive regardless of its registered outcomes.
